title: 'Disappointed with PM Modi': Shehzad Poonawalla’s sarcastic 'dictator' jibe at oppn
content: Taking a jibe at PM Modi's critics, Shehzad Poonawalla expressed "disappointment" with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership style.  He sarcastically suggested Modi learn dictatorship from past Congress leaders.  Poonawalla cited Indira Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru as examples of strong rule.  He also mentioned past Congress governments' actions during protests.  The former spokesperson concluded Modi had not met Left-liberal expectations.

title: Delhi teen raped multiple times by friend; case comes to light after her pregnancy
content: A 17-year-old girl from Delhi has accused her friend of multiple rapes in a Gurugram hotel. The alleged incidents occurred between January and March 2026, police stated. A case was registered after the teenager became pregnant and was medically examined. The FIR was filed under POCSO and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita sections. Police are investigating and conducting raids to apprehend the accused.

title: 'Sexually explicit language': Complaint over Insta video targeting Rahul Gandhi
content: A KPCC Legal Cell member filed a police complaint regarding an Instagram post. The post contained defamatory and objectionable content targeting Rahul Gandhi. Several users also posted abusive and sexually explicit comments on the video. Police registered a case under the IT Act and BNS for investigation. Measures are being taken to delete the video and trace the account administrator.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Happy Friendship Day 2026: 50 wishes, messages and quotes to share
content: Friendship Day 2026 falls on Sunday, August 2, celebrating connections. The article offers fifty wishes and quotes for expressing appreciation. These messages cater to heartfelt, funny, and short sentiments for friends. It also includes specific wishes for childhood and long-distance friendships. Famous quotes about friendship are provided for sharing with loved ones.

title: DMK moves SC seeking immediate release of Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu
content: The DMK has petitioned the Supreme Court for immediate Cauvery water release from Karnataka.  Karnataka's government faces a directive to release 3,500 cusecs daily for fifteen days.  The plea also seeks to clear an accumulated water release shortfall of 9.46 TMC.  Karnataka's Chief Minister urged protesters to withdraw their agitation against water releases.  The state government will protect farmers' interests while respecting judicial orders.

title: UPI reaches new milestone with highest-ever transaction value of Rs 29.88 lakh crore
content: India's UPI platform achieved its highest monthly transaction value ever.  In July, transaction volumes also reached a new record high.  The platform processed billions of transactions, surpassing previous records.  This sustained growth strengthens India's digital payment ecosystem significantly.  UPI is also expanding its global footprint across several countries.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Hospital staff plan wedding in 24 hours before bride’s brain surgery
content: A Colorado couple who had been together for 15 years tied the knot inside a hospital just days before the bride underwent major brain tumour surgery, after nurses and caregivers organised an entire wedding in less than 24 hours. Gary Clayson proposed to his longtime partner, Anne, on July 23 at AdventHealth Porter in Denver after learning she was scheduled for intensive surgery to remove a large brain tumour.

title: William and Kate make rare family appearance at Glasgow Commonwealth Games
content: Prince William and Kate Middleton briefly paused their summer break to attend the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland, on Saturday, August 1, making it a rare family outing with their three children - Prince George, Princess Charlotte and Prince Louis. The appearance marked the siblings' first official public engagement in Scotland.

title: Canada’s new Study Permit rules: An officer shall not issue visa unless these conditions are met
content: Canada has updated study permit rules, increasing financial scrutiny for applicants. Immigration officers will now examine both the amount and source of applicant funds. This change broadens the assessment beyond previous high-risk environment considerations. Applicants may need to provide additional financial and employment documents for verification. The minimum financial requirement for study permits remains unchanged by these updates.

title: Fire breaks out at judicial magistrate's office in Bihar; records reduced to ashes
content: A significant fire erupted at the Judicial Magistrate First Class office on Saturday morning.  The blaze destroyed numerous important case files and legal records before court proceedings began.  Firefighting teams battled for hours to bring the flames under control after the incident.  Officials are now assessing the extensive damage and investigating the fire's cause.  Hearings scheduled for Saturday have been postponed due to the fire.

title: 'Kept motivating me': Jadumani Singh credits Sarita Devi for his CWG silver medal journey
content: Jadumani Singh Mandengbam secured a silver medal at the Commonwealth Games. He credited veteran boxer Sarita Devi for her significant support and guidance. Sarita Devi's daily advice and encouragement were crucial to his journey. The young boxer aims to improve and perform well in future competitions. This silver medal will motivate him to work even harder.

title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after $325M success
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field

title: How Lamine Yamal’s parents shaped football’s most emotional World Cup story
content: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.

title: 'Go that way': Illegal migrants say Moroccan authorities directed them towards Ceuta
content: Moroccan illegal migrants reported encouragement from authorities and social media messages.  Thousands crossed into Spain's Ceuta enclave, with many returning due to hardship.  At least sixty-seven people died during the unprecedented border crossing event.  Spain is reinforcing the Ceuta border after tens of thousands entered.  The crisis has sparked political tensions and renewed migration policy debates.

title: Indian equities ‘probably oversold’: FIIs warm up after months of outflows
content: Foreign investors are showing renewed interest in Indian equities after significant outflows. Geopolitical uncertainties and elevated oil prices continue to pose risks to the outlook. India's domestic economy demonstrates robust performance with healthy sales and credit growth. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to align its monetary policy with the US Federal Reserve. Delays in bond index inclusion reflect global market dynamics, not India's debt concerns.

title: Bengal to clear all pending CAA applications within six months, says Suvendu Adhikari
content: West Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari pledged to resolve all pending CAA applications soon. He stated the law grants citizenship and is not meant to revoke it. Nearly twenty-four thousand citizenship certificates have already been issued to eligible refugees. The government will delegate powers to district magistrates for faster application processing. This initiative aims to provide citizenship to persecuted minorities from neighboring countries.

title: Build within 5 years or lose your govt-allotted plot: Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar
content: The Karnataka government is set to reclaim plots that have not seen any construction within five years. Beneficiaries will be reimbursed their payments along with accrued interest. This initiative seeks to tackle the issue of abandoned sites turning into dumping grounds. The government encourages property owners to develop their plots, particularly those allotted by BDA, CITB, and cooperative societies.

title: Bengal CM, Jantar Mantar protest: SIT reveals arrested JeM operative's target list
content: An alleged Jaish-e-Mohammed operative was arrested by West Bengal STF. Hamim Mondal planned to target Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and disrupt a Delhi protest. He intended to disguise himself in a police uniform for sabotage activities. Mondal was in contact with Pakistan-based handlers through encrypted messaging applications. The investigation is ongoing to uncover the full extent of the terror network.

title: Video shows inferno after Russian missile barrage leaves 9 dead in Ukraine

Kyiv and surrounding regions were targeted in the second major aerial assault in two days.  Ukrainian authorities reported 27 ballistic missiles were fired, with only one intercepted.  President Zelensky renewed urgent calls for more Western air defence systems.

title: Rs 32 crore, boardroom feud, contract killers: How chairman plotted MD’s murder

He allegedly failed to repay the large sum owed after selling his company stake.  Financial losses in stock markets reportedly pushed the chairman into debt.  Police arrested seven individuals, including the alleged shooter, in connection with the plot.

The couple had been married for thirteen years and had two sons.

The gold medal fulfilled her aim of improving on her previous performance.

Addressing these areas preserves functionality and market competitiveness effectively.
